Prince Edward Island's four lower thresholds, left carried forward at the federal 2.0% factor until now, are 33,928 / 65,820 / 106,890 / 142,520 - each the 2025 figure indexed by PEI's own 1.8% factor (33,328 / 64,656 / 105,000 / 140,000 x 1.018) - per CRA T4032PE effective 1 July 2026 and the PEI table in T4127, 123rd edition; the BPA stays $15,000 and the 20% bracket over $200,000 is unchanged (CRA withholds a prorated 21% from July, which is a withholding mechanic, not the annual rate). The January 2026 edition of T4032PE, and Wealthsimple's 2026 PEI calculator which follows it, print $142,250 for the fourth threshold with a provincial constant of $6,460; both July editions print $142,520 with $6,464, and 6,464 is the arithmetically correct constant for 142,520, so the July figure is used.
